styles.name: vp-tunnel
styles.description: Concentric rectangles converge to a center vanishing point; rings fly toward the viewer — depth filled = eased, forward rush = time

styles.name: road-horizon
styles.description: Two rails converge at a horizon point; dashed center line scrolls toward the viewer — how far you've driven = eased

styles.name: starfield-dive
styles.description: Stars stream from the center vanishing point outward; streak length = warp speed from eased; active-star count grows with progress

styles.name: wire-corridor
styles.description: Wireframe corridor: floor, ceiling, and wall grid lines converge to a central vanishing point; floor lines scroll forward with time

styles.name: checker-floor
styles.description: Perspective checkerboard floor: rows compress toward the horizon; pattern scrolls toward the viewer with time; depth = eased

styles.name: infinite-hallway
styles.description: Nested doorframe rectangles at increasing depth — each door crossed = one step of eased; doors scroll toward viewer with time

styles.name: mine-shaft
styles.description: Descending shaft: floor markers scroll upward with time; depth gauge on the right fills with eased; you're falling down and in

styles.name: depth-brackets
styles.description: Nested [ [ [ > ] ] ] bracket pairs zoom inward; visible depth = eased; inner marker pulses with time — pure typographic perspective

styles.name: approach-gate
styles.description: A portal ring grows from the vanishing point until it fills the screen at 100%; multiple rings stream toward the viewer continuously

styles.name: pipe-wormhole
styles.description: Circular pipe tunnel with radial spokes; spokes rotate with time as you travel through — rings fill in with eased for depth

styles.name: parallax-layers
styles.description: Three line-layers scroll at 3× speed ratios — background, midground, foreground — giving pure parallax depth; layer count = eased
